Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 1989
ORDINANCE II OF
1989
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
NO.1371 (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1989
An Ordinance to
repeal Martial Law Order No. 1371, dated February 9, 1984 issued by M.L.A. Zone
A
(Punjab) (Ban on
Students Unions)
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 22nd January, 1989]
No. Legis.3(2)/89, dated
22-1-1989.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1). This Ordinance may be called the Martial Law Order
No.1371 (Repeal) Ordinance, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
